# fct_training_track_engagement

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_training_track_engagement` · dbt area: `training`

Fact table for advisor training track engagement in Portal. Each row represents an advisor's progress within a single track, including advisors who started but did not complete. Pre-calculated completion status, module/lesson counts, and time-to-complete. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `training_track_engagement_id` | Primary Key. Surrogate key for each advisor × track record. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The advisor (user_id from portal). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_signup_to_track_complete` | Calendar days from advisor signup to track completion. NULL if not completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_signup_to_track_start` | Calendar days from advisor signup to their first lesson completion in this track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_to_track_complete` | Calendar days from first to last lesson completion within the track. NULL if track not completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `first_lesson_completed_at` | When the advisor completed their first lesson in this track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_track_completed` | True if the advisor has completed all non-archived lessons in the track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_lessons_complete` | Number of lessons the advisor has fully completed in this track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_modules_complete` | Number of modules the advisor has fully completed in this track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_completed_at` | When the advisor completed the final lesson in this track. NULL if not fully completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_id` | Foreign Key. The track being measured. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_name` | Display name of the track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
